title: The First Portal Was a Trap: Run
movie_note: The movie's FINALE 1/5, part 3 (story/movie/finale1_shots.md), re-paced on the creator's notes of 2026-11-27: the 6 s slow-motion after 'RUN!' and the empty whip-pan cut; a 1.2 s slow-motion shock beat (Null's grin looming, ear ring, one heartbeat) before 'RUN!'; hard cut on 'RUN!' into the sprint; the chase on war drums (taikos, dark synth bass, dissonant string ostinato) instead of the retro groove; the overhead split held longer; Null's head flicks to Steve then snaps to the Noob on a distortion chime; a wide shot of Null banking down the right path after the Noob. The three lines are the published takes (lifted from run 43015597357's mix: movie/finale1_published/p3).
